The {{artworkCount}} illustrations include color views and line drawings of business aircraft, light planes and trainers. Pick a clear side profile to label in a general aviation lesson, or use an angled view for a personal flight log cover.

paragraphs: A King Air with two propellers looks quite different from a Bonanza with one. Explore those recognizable shapes in this Beechcraft aircraft clipart set, then look for the Starship and its distinctive forward wings.
